name: Desideratum
source:
"Things desired or desirable, that which is lacking or required."

He's dead. 

But he doesn't have to stay that way.

A visual novel about loss, grief, recovery, tea, and watering your plants.

[From [url=https://beepsalt.itch.io/desideratum]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“想要的或想要的东西，缺乏的或需要的东西。”

他死了。

但他不必一直这样。

一部关于失落、悲伤、恢复、茶和浇灌植物的视觉小说。

[来自[url=https://beepsalt.itch.io/desideratum]Itch.io[/url]]
